789-2842-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
789-2842-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Blood Artist, Gutter Grime and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Gutter Grime ability, creating a X/X Ooze creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1864-2034-4758.description:
Cast Prossh from the command zone by paying {3}{B}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Prossh triggers, creating a 0/1 Kobolds of Kher Keep token for each mana spent to cast it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Prossh, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to return Prossh from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Kobolds of Kher Keep tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Crossroads Candleguide three times by paying {6}, adding {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Kobolds of Kher Keep token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 7 until you have enough mana to cast Prossh.
Repeat from step 1.

967-3809-4365-6495-7087.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
967-3809-4365-6495-7087.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

4067-7922.easyPrerequisites: Your starting deck had 200 or more cards in it.
4067-7922.description:
Activate Whtz by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Whtz.
Repeat.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

1993-4300-7857.easyPrerequisites: You control eight or fewer lands.
1993-4300-7857.notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
1993-4300-7857.description:
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Elven Raft-Steerer triggers, untapping Budoka Gardener
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Repeat.

1987-2556-6259.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-2556-6259.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Mnemonic Wall.
When Mnemonic Wall enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2556-6259.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

2438-3497-4907-6989.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 3 life this turn.
2438-3497-4907-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Ezzaroot Channeler. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

240-5470-6797-7175.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Land with Cycling Cost that can be paid using one colored mana

717-2628-5181--38.description:
Activate the land's cycling ability by paying {1} and discarding it.
When you cycle the land, Escape Protocol and Bone Miser's second ability trigger.
Resolve Bone Miser's ability, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve Escape Protocol's ability, paying {1} to blink Golgari Findbroker.
When Golgari Findbroker enters, it triggers, returning the cycled land from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the activated ability from step 1, drawing a card.
717-2628-5181--38.notes: You can discard down to maximum hand size at end of turn to trigger Bone Miser's abilities many times.

3532-5078-6769-7010.easyPrerequisites: There are at least two counters on creatures you control.
3532-5078-6769-7010.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
3532-5078-6769-7010.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Diving Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters the battlefield, Surge Conductor triggers, putting a counter on a creature you control that already has a counter on it.
Repeat.

3532-3836-5078-5240.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Oneirophage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

3558-4050-5220-6900.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds
When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1738-2939-5306.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is higher than or equal to an opponent's.
1738-2939-5306.description:
Activate Disciple of Griselbrand by paying {1} and sacrificing Serra Avatar, causing you to gain life equal to Serra Avatar's toughness.
Defiant Bloodlord triggers, causing target opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained.

1395-4474-5051-5078.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Elsha and Traxos trigger.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Traxos trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

1069-1232-5295-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1232-5295-5499.description:
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

777-1020-3689-6518.description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4050-5043-5078-5741.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Alela triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Faerie, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Repeat.

342-2645-4667-5903.notablePrerequisites: Elvish Aberration does not have summoning sickness.
342-2645-4667-5903.description:
Activate Elvish Aberration by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Elvish Aberration.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {0}, untapping it.
Repeat.

4871-5231-5626-6415.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing another creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Wriggling Grub from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Wriggling Grub, adding {R}.
When Wriggling Grub dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Wriggling Grub trigger, creating two 1/1 Worm creature tokens.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1651-4321-5056-5251.description:
Activate Neurok Transmuter by paying {U}, causing Emmara to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Emmara and another artifact, targeting Emmara.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability, untapping Emmara.
Repeat from step 2.

222-527-955-5147.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-955-5147.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1247-5536-5840.notablePrerequisites:
Rex does not have summoning sickness.
Nantuko Elder and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
1247-5536-5840.description:
Activate Rex using Nantuko Elder's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{G}.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

372-2239-3563.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Flicker of Fate exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Ardent Elementalist exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Flicker of Fate.
372-2239-3563.description:
Cast Flicker of Fate by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Ardent Elementalist and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Ardent Elementalist trigger.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist trigger, returning Flicker of Fate from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Flicker of Fate.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Ardent Elementalist and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

745-1525-2031-2406-2660.notablePrerequisites:
Mirrorhall Mimic // Ghastly Mimicry is a copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
745-1525-2031-2406-2660.description:
Cast Lightning Storm by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting either copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Stormchaser Drake triggers, which due to Abundance causes you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Activate Lightning Storm by discarding a land card, putting that land card on the bottom of your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Resolve the Lightning Storm ability, putting two charge counters on it and changing the target to the other copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Repeat from step 2.
Once Lightning Storm has an arbitrarily large number of charge counters, activate it by discarding a land to change its target to any other target of your choosing to deal infinite damage to that target.
745-1525-2031-2406-2660.notes: Other players may also activate Lightning Storm to change its target, making this combo risky if you do not have additional land cards in hand to activate Lightning Storm again.

722-3153-3388.notablePrerequisites: Moritte of the Frost is a copy of Sphinx of the Second Sun.
722-3153-3388.description:
Cast Chronomantic Escape by paying {4}{W}{W}, causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and putting Chronomantic Escape into exile with three time counters on it.
At the beginning of your postcombat main phase, both copies of Sphinx of the Second Sun trigger, causing you to get two additional beginning phases after this phase.
Move to your first additional beginning phase.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself and causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Chronomantic Escape,  causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and putting Chronomantic Escape into exile with three time counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

855-3933-4929-5479.notablePrerequisites:
Lost Jitte has at least one charge counter on it.
Cryptic Trilobite has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
855-3933-4929-5479.description:
Activate Karn's Bastion by paying {4}, putting a charge counter on Lost Jitte and two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Lost Jitte by removing a charge counter from it, untapping Karn's Bastion.
Repeat.

1309-4050-5117.description:
Cast Undying Malice by paying {B}, targeting Salvager of Secrets.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Salvager of Secrets, adding {B}.
When Salvager of Secrets dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Undying Malice from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2223-2707-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Anurid Scavenger triggers, causing you to put Walk the Aeons on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your draw step, drawing Walk the Aeons from the bottom of your library due to River Song.
Repeat.

1857-4968.notablePrerequisites:
Deathbringer Thoctar has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Gift of Doom attached to Deathbringer Thoctar.
1857-4968.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any creature an opponent controls.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to Deathbringer Thoctar's deathtouch.
Deathbringer Thoctar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat as desired.
You may also repeat this combo whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

2067-3858-5323.notablePrerequisites: Your life total plus the number of creatures you control is equal to or greater than nineteen.
2067-3858-5323.description:
Cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}{W}, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Pegasus creature tokens equal to your life total.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain ten life and win the game.

1456-3836-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

643-914-1327-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Opponents control at least two artifacts and/or enchantments.
Cleaver Skaab does not have summoning sickness.
643-914-1327-2178.description:
Activate Cleaver Skaab by paying {3}, tapping it and sacrificing Dockside Extortionist.
Dockside Extortionist dies, triggering Cleaver Skaab, untapping Cleaver Skaab.
Resolve the Cleaver Skaab ability from step 1, creating two token copies of Dockside Extortionist.
The Dockside Extortionist tokens enter the battlefield, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.
